comments:
The cover page in the reproduction is printed in reverse and upside-down and does not seem to correspond to that text.
[8H6M69W4] does not list any corresponding item with the signature "phyi la 501."
After fol. 110, one find pages from p. 280 to p. 412 of a type-set edition with folios numbered 111 to 206, presumably making up for lost folios. These are followed by the remaining handwritten folios numbered 170 to 314.
